catalyst.name: Collective Action, Devil's Ruin Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Elemental Pickup Interactions grant 30% [10%] increased damage for a variable duration based on the pickup. Can be activated while stowed.
Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, and Tangle Detonations grant the buff for 4 seconds. Throwing a held Tangle grants 4 additional seconds. Firesprites and Void Breaches grant the buff for 8 seconds.
Additional Pickups can extend the duration up to the maximum of 16 seconds.
Elemental Pickup Interactions:
• Destroying a Tangle (or Elemental Orbs), either by shooting or throwing.
• Collecting Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, or Void Breaches
Does not trigger with Stasis Shards generated from Facet of Awakening or Facet of Command.
